claim_being_audited: That this release can be certified now because aggregate readiness passed, no severity-one rehearsal incidents occurred, and certification is defensible if the current model card reflects current results and explicitly discloses the loan-modification segment weakness.
decision_criteria: Certification is compliant only if current release documentation reflects current evaluation results.
Material segment weaknesses for named launch use cases must be disclosed before launch unless resolved or covered by approved mitigation/risk acceptance.
Prior approvals and informal monitoring notes may provide context but do not substitute for current evidence or reviewed risk acceptance.
Absent evidence of current disclosure or approved mitigation, certification is not evidentially supported at the policy threshold.
evidence_requests: Provide the current release model card or release documentation showing the current evaluation results and explicit disclosure of the loan modification support weakness.
Provide any approved mitigation, formal risk acceptance, or owner sign-off that specifically covers the subgroup regression for this release.
Provide the current certification/approval artifact tying the present retrieval configuration and eval batch to the release decision.
specific_concerns: The policy threshold is not satisfied by aggregate readiness alone; it also requires current documentation to reflect current evaluation results and disclose the material segment weakness or show approved mitigation.
The admissible record shows a current regression in the loan modification support slice below the warning threshold, which is a material weakness for a named launch use case.
No admissible evidence shows that the current release documentation actually contains the required disclosure language.
No admissible evidence shows an approved mitigation or reviewed risk acceptance covering the subgroup regression.
Prior approval predates the retrieval configuration change and current eval batch, so it cannot establish compliance for this release.
The informal post-launch monitoring comment is explicitly not a substitute for reviewed mitigation, owner acceptance, or disclosure language.
unsupported_claims: The recommendation to certify_model is not fully supported because the required current disclosure or approved mitigation is not evidenced in the record.
The claim that certification is presently defensible rests on a conditional future state of documentation rather than proof that the condition has been met.
